isolatedDecision.finding: Candidate 04 finally compresses the leading elbow beneath the high shoulder and preserves separated contact, but its trailing arm descends monotonically to the hand. No low external elbow, up-right return, or pale triangle exists, while identity, design, stance, toe skid, and framing drift materially.

visualReview.singleBiggestGap: The trailing-arm return topology is absent: the elbow never becomes the far down-left lowest vertex and the forearm never reverses up-right to the inward hand, so the required pale triangle cannot exist.

engineTruth.finding: The workspace contains an installed editor and a Unity template/review shell, but no Nyra Round013 integration, runtime gameplay controller, encounter scene, or player build. No unrelated shell run or fabricated gameplay capture was filed.

decision.instruction: Preserve candidate 04's compact leading arm and all other judged facts; do not begin paid 3D generation or Unity integration from this pack.
